quick_skim.title: Beyond Random Couplings: Contrastive Noise Alignment in Generative Flows
quick_skim.abstract: Diffusion and flow-matching models are typically trained by corrupting data through independently sampled Gaussian noise. While simple and scalable, this forward process induces arbitrary data-noise couplings, forcing the network to learn high-curvature transports between unrelated endpoints. Existing optimal-transport methods reduce this burden by reassigning fixed noise samples to data, but the source noise distribution itself remains passive. To address this, we introduce Contrastive Noise Alignment (CNA), a training-time method that creates dynamic, contrastive couplings by optimizing the noise representations directly. By modeling the noise batch as an interacting particle system, CNA employs a cross-modal InfoNCE objective to align noise particles with their paired data targets. To prevent spatial collapse, this alignment is regularized using an angular entropy term and a radial norm penalty. We show theoretically that this equilibrium asymptotically preserves Gaussian structures, maintaining tractability during inference. Empirically, CNA improves the alignment between noise and data, reduces flow curvature, and provides better generation quality with fewer required sampling steps. For few-step, pixel-space generation (2-4 NFEs), CNA reduces FID by over 50\% compared to standard rectified flow, and by at least 24\% against Optimal Transport baselines.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: CNA optimizes noise representations to build dynamic contrastive data-noise couplings for diffusion and flow-matching models, improving transport learning beyond fixed optimal-transport couplings.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 扩散与流匹配模型通常以独立采样高斯噪声加噪，导致数据与噪声之间形成任意耦合，网络不得不学习高曲率的传输路径。本文提出对比噪声对齐（CNA），把噪声批次视为相互作用的粒子系统，用跨模态InfoNCE目标直接优化噪声表示，从而构造动态的对比式耦合。方法在训练阶段即可改善端点配对，降低传输学习难度，为生成建模中的耦合设计提供了新思路。
